messages:
nina: FYI I put a short RFC draft in drive: https://rdw.in/kv-attn-rfc
nina: Goal: combine a KV-prefetch policy with a new attention kernel prioritization to reduce tail latency for small-batch chat traffic while keeping quality stable for long-context workloads.
nina: Constraints: must be off-by-default, model-config opt-in, and reversible via flag per-model/per-deployment. Launch criteria below.
sam: Quick Q — is the kernel selection purely runtime heuristics or do we need a compile-time model variant? Want to know rollout complexity.
nina: runtime heur + model hints. plan: kernels chosen by (model_family, quantization, seq_len_hint) + runtime stats. compile-time variants only for nvcc-specialized builds.
jorge: Edge case: long-context streams with periodic user edits can thrash the KV cache. Proposal: add a TTL-based eviction + per-request pinning. Example policy:
```
{"kv_policy": "ttl=30m, max_entries=20000, pin_on_prefetch=true"}
```
jorge: Also need acceptance test that synthetic long-context trace doesn't degrade p95 by >10%.
austin: Adding context: Acme wants 30ms p95 on 8-token responses for small-batch chat on Dedicated. They'll trial canary if we give an escape hatch. So product asks: per-model enable flag, telemetry exports, and a rollback knob.
emily: SRE concerns: need automated rollback when error-rate spike >0.5% OR latency p99 regresses >20% vs baseline. Also add tracing spans for kernel decision path and KV hit/miss metrics.
sam: Proposed rollout plan:
- stage 0: internal perf tests + canary infra (1 host pool)
- stage 1: Dedicated canary for 1 willing customer (Acme) for 48h
- stage 2: regional gradual rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%)
sam: Perf gates:
- p95 latency for target workload <= baseline * 0.95 OR at least not > baseline * 1.10
- quality (eval prompts) mean logprob drift <= 0.5 pts
- cost per token delta <= +15% (unless explicitly approved)
jorge: Acceptance criteria (PRD/RFC style):
- unit tests for kernel selection logic
- integration test with KV eviction traces
- perf harness reproducing 95th and 99th latency
- A/B eval suite with 500 prompt pairs, automated diff check
emily: Runbook edits: add steps to disable new kernel on router, commands:
```
# disable kernel for model foo
rdwctl models set-flag foo --kernel=legacy
# force fallback
rdwctl router set-fallback --policy=always
```
emily: And add synthetic smoke that runs every 5m to detect regressions.
nina: Owner assignments: sam -> rollout plan + perf gates; jorge -> KV policy + tests; emily -> observability + runbooks; austin -> customer coordination + contract for Acme canary.
nina: Timeline: RFC ready for review by Fri (3 days). Canaries start next Wed if approved.
sam: I can draft the kernel decision pseudo-code today. ping me for clarifications.
jorge: I'll add a small simulator to the perf harness to validate TTL vs size heuristics.
austin: I'll confirm Acme's contact and get signed NDA for canary by EOD.
emily: I'll prepare alerting playbook and a sample Grafana dashboard panel names.
deploy-bot: canary:kv-attn started on pool "canary-01" at 1842056945
nina: perfect, thanks. if anyone hits obvious regressions drop into #incidents and tag @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
sam: +1
jorge: +1
emily: noted, will monitor. "metrics.alert.kv_kernel_errors" added to oncall dashboard.
